description: Strip ONLY the dev-panel scaffolding (the layout.tsx mount, app/_fontlab/, public/fontlab/ preview fonts) — any applied font change and copy edits are left intact. PREFER font_lab_finish: it runs this AND returns the git-verified commit plan in one call, which is what the end of a session actually needs. Reach for bare uninit only when you want the scaffolding gone mid-session (e.g. the human wants to keep exploring later but commit now).

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the user's project root (any framework — Next.js, Vite, Astro, Remix, SvelteKit, TanStack, …).

name: font_lab_uninit
